games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from Code Name: Bonanza, part 1: Imani felt the _____ diminish. Their odds shrank like morning mist.
rounds.answer: momentum
rounds.explanation: The text says: Imani felt the momentum diminish. Momentum is the force of something moving forward, which is exactly what the failed demo drained away.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from Code Name: Bonanza, part 2: "We did our best," she said, refusing to be drawn into his _____ games.
rounds.answer: insolent
rounds.explanation: The text says: refusing to be drawn into his insolent games. Insolent means rude and disrespectful, which matches Nadir's taunt about panicking.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from Code Name: Bonanza, part 2: The room felt _____, suddenly full of promise. Empty space had become opportunity.
rounds.answer: capacious
rounds.explanation: The text says: The room felt capacious, suddenly full of promise. Capacious means roomy and able to hold a great deal; desolate would contradict the hopeful mood.

games.title: Reading Detective

rounds.prompt: According to The Power of Persuasion, what three tools do modern advertisers use to target specific audiences?
choices: Modern advertisers use psychology, data analysis and visual design to aim their messages at specific audiences.
Their project was a waste-sorting drone, and it was glitchy because it sometimes confused recyclable plastic with food waste.
She refused because the team had no proof, and she said that without proof the rumours were just noise.
rounds.answer: Modern advertisers use psychology, data analysis and visual design to aim their messages at specific audiences.
rounds.explanation: The paragraph explaining that modern advertising is more intricate than a market trader's shouting says advertisers use psychology, data analysis and visual design to target audiences.

rounds.prompt: In the interview, what did the advert claim about the trainers Zara bought, and what did she discover after buying them?
choices: The judges said Team Spark impressed them not only with innovation but with transparency and teamwork, demonstrating growth, strategy and an eye for ethical application.
Modern advertisers use psychology, data analysis and visual design to aim their messages at specific audiences.
The advert called them the most comfortable shoes ever made, but when Zara bought them they were not as comfortable as the advert claimed.
rounds.answer: The advert called them the most comfortable shoes ever made, but when Zara bought them they were not as comfortable as the advert claimed.
rounds.explanation: Zara says the advert called the trainers 'the most comfortable shoes ever made', but after buying them she found they were not as comfortable as it claimed.

rounds.prompt: How did the judges explain their decision to award first place to Team Spark?
choices: The advert called them the most comfortable shoes ever made, but when Zara bought them they were not as comfortable as the advert claimed.
The judges said Team Spark impressed them not only with innovation but with transparency and teamwork, demonstrating growth, strategy and an eye for ethical application.
She refused because the team had no proof, and she said that without proof the rumours were just noise.
rounds.answer: The judges said Team Spark impressed them not only with innovation but with transparency and teamwork, demonstrating growth, strategy and an eye for ethical application.
rounds.explanation: The judges say Team Spark impressed them with transparency and teamwork as well as innovation, showing growth, strategy and ethical thinking, which is why they placed first.

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: What does 'gusto' mean?
choices: Worried or anxious about something that might happen.
Angry and ready to fight or argue.
Small and delicate in a way that is attractive.
Enjoyment or enthusiasm in doing something.
rounds.answer: Enjoyment or enthusiasm in doing something.
rounds.explanation: Gusto is wholehearted enthusiasm, like the energy Team Spark brought to rebuilding their drone; the other options define apprehensive, belligerent and dainty.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from Code Name: Bonanza, part 1: Their biggest _____ was Team Horizon, led by Nadir — the kind of competitor who smiled sweetly while planting doubts in your mind.
rounds.answer: adversary
rounds.explanation: The text says: Their biggest adversary was Team Horizon. An adversary is an opponent, which fits a rival team; accord and concession are agreement words, and apprehensive describes worry.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from Code Name: Bonanza, part 1: Created by a _____ team, The Beacon seemed flawless. Too flawless.
rounds.answer: cunning
rounds.explanation: The text says: Created by a cunning team, The Beacon seemed flawless. Cunning means clever in a deceptive way, which matches the copying rumours around Team Horizon.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: What does 'aptitude' mean?
choices: The way a person behaves or shows their feelings.
A natural ability to do something well.
Enjoyment or enthusiasm in doing something.
Something that is given up or allowed in order to reach an agreement.
rounds.answer: A natural ability to do something well.
rounds.explanation: Aptitude is a natural talent, as in the story where Imani is known for her sharp aptitude in algorithms; the other options define demeanor, gusto and concession.

rounds.prompt: What does 'concession' mean?
choices: Something that is given up or allowed in order to reach an agreement.
The force or speed of something moving, especially when it is getting faster.
A person or group that opposes or fights against another.
An agreement or harmony between people or groups.
rounds.answer: Something that is given up or allowed in order to reach an agreement.
rounds.explanation: A concession is something surrendered to reach a deal, like Nadir's offer to collaborate next year; the other options define momentum, adversary and accord.

rounds.prompt: What does 'obsolete' mean?
choices: Difficult to find, catch, or achieve.
Having a lot of space; able to hold a lot of things.
No longer used or needed because something newer exists.
Paying close attention to something or someone.
rounds.answer: No longer used or needed because something newer exists.
rounds.explanation: Obsolete describes things replaced by newer inventions, such as the fax machines discussed in the Before and After activity; the other options define elusive, capacious and attentive.
